abstract.p: Translating name entities can be challenging, as it often requires real-world knowledge rather than just performing a literal translation. The shared task "Entity-Aware Machine Translation" in SemEval-2025 encourages participants to build machine translation models that can effectively handle the translation of complex named entities. In this paper, we propose two methods to improve the accuracy of name entity translation from English to Japanese. One approach involves fine-tuning the model on entries, or lists of entries, of the dictionary. The second technique focuses on preference optimization, guiding the model on which translation it should generate.
